technical_limits: Telegram content protection reduces forwarding, screenshots and media saving but cannot prevent an authorized viewer from using another device to photograph or manually transcribe content.

FREE is intentionally public for discovery and acquisition. Public visibility means external reading/scraping cannot be technically guaranteed against; therefore no sensitive or exclusive Premium/STAKAZO content may be published there before settlement.
Bot API cannot enumerate every ordinary channel subscriber for arbitrary bot detection; security is enforced primarily through private access, join approval and administrator allowlisting.
